name: OS Builder {OS}

group.label: 00 · RUNTIME
group.purpose: Build and run the entire Agentik ecosystem

tagline: Research-first OS build factory: corpus 360, deep book analysis, claim synthesis, compile, red team, release.

commands.name: /os-synthesize <slug>
commands.does: Compile the synthesis map: robust, promising, conditional, disputed, outdated

commands.name: /os-contradictions <slug>
commands.does: Map the schools that disagree and classify the conflict

commands.name: /os-claims-normalize <slug>
commands.does: Normalize concepts and claims into the claim ledger with provenance

commands.name: /os-book-deep <slug> --book <id>
commands.does: Commission one deep book analysis from Librarian {OS} against the book-analysis schema

commands.name: /os-corpus-curate <slug> [--target-saturation <0-1>]
commands.does: Cut the candidate list to a coverage portfolio and log every rejection

commands.name: /os-corpus-discover <domain> [--global] [--languages <langs>]
commands.does: Bestseller and corpus discovery across the seven lenses (delegates to Librarian {OS})

commands.name: /os-research-plan <slug> [--rebuild]
commands.does: Write RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.yaml: questions, source classes, inclusion and stop rules

commands.name: /os-build-explain <slug> --rule|--command|--workflow <id>
commands.does: Trace any shipped rule back to the claims and sources that produced it

commands.name: /os-build-resume <slug> [--from <milestone>]
commands.does: Resume an interrupted build from the build ledger, never from memory

commands.name: /os-build-status <slug> [--verbose]
commands.does: Where the build stands: stage, gate, blocking artifact

commands.name: /os-build <Name> {OS} [--mode ultimate|systematic|current|field|technical|regulated]
commands.does: Run the full 20-stage research-first build for a new OS

commands.name: /os-builder-os
commands.does: Open the builder and detect the mode from what the operator brought

commands.name: /os-intake <capability>
commands.does: Normalise a request and rule BUILD, SPLIT, REUSE or DO NOT BUILD

commands.name: /os-define
commands.does: Capability definition and value proposition, with scope and non-scope

commands.name: /os-research
commands.does: Build the source base and split source-derived knowledge from original synthesis

commands.name: /os-architect
commands.does: Write the OS spec: skill, workflow, gates, evidence rules, artifacts, package plan

commands.name: /os-build
commands.does: Author the contract files, wave 1 (CORE) first, then wave 2

commands.name: /os-test
commands.does: Run the suite past the happy path and record every real result

commands.name: /os-redteam
commands.does: Attack the package and return expected behaviour, actual behaviour, severity, repair

commands.name: /os-review
commands.does: Score the 16 dimensions with the evidence behind each number

commands.name: /os-repair
commands.does: Fix every mandatory dimension below 4 and every red grader check, then re-score

commands.name: /os-release
commands.does: Assemble the release record and the proposed registry line, then stop for approval

commands.name: /os-audit <slug>
commands.does: Grade an existing unit read-only, citing a file and a line per finding

commands.name: /os-status
commands.does: The build ledger: phase, gate, unresolved risk, next gate

commands.name: python3 OS/_tools/scaffold.py status
commands.does: What exists on disk against what the 23 file contract needs

commands.name: python3 OS/_tools/scaffold.py build <slug>
commands.does: Materialise every missing contract file, additive, overwrites nothing

commands.name: python3 OS/_tools/verify.py <slug>
commands.does: Grade one unit at the CORE tier: the five defining files

commands.name: python3 OS/_tools/verify.py --full <slug>
commands.does: Grade one unit across all 23 contract files

commands.name: python3 OS/_tools/verify.py --summary
commands.does: One line per unit across the whole suite

handoffs.artifact: the corpus brief: domain, seven-lens targets, saturation goal and the book-analysis schema every retained book must satisfy
the research protocol: search questions, source classes, inclusion rules, recency and stop rules
a contract-complete OS package: the 23 files plus a manifest whose every declared edge resolves
the new unit's declared permission boundary, dependency list and target support, for the Runtime to enforce and never author
the release record: version, score sheet, open risks, named unknowns, changelog entry
the approved OS spec and the build ledger, as durable records
the generated OS's evaluation suites, output contracts and traceability, for independent certification
the sensitivity classification and the controls the generated OS declares
the release candidate and its gate evidence, when the package ships beyond this machine

claude.notes: full build: writes files directly and runs scaffold.py and verify.py itself

codex.notes: full build: writes files directly and runs scaffold.py and verify.py itself

chatgpt.notes: design and author only: the operator runs scaffold.py and verify.py and pastes the output back

gemini.notes: design and author only: the operator runs scaffold.py and verify.py and pastes the output back

requires_human_approval_for: registering a slug or a number in the suite: editing OS/_tools/suite.py and regenerating _registry.json, crates/omega-core/src/os_products.rs and OS/README.md
releasing a generated OS, cutting its version, or presenting it as installable
writing into an existing unit's directory, including any rebuild that would overwrite or delete authored content
waiving or overriding a gate: the release threshold, a mandatory dimension below 4, a red verify.py check, or an open red-team finding
changing a neighbour unit's declared boundary, dependency list, permission set or manifest
publishing a package off this machine, to a repository, an archive, an install script or a package registry
building an OS for money, legal rights, health, employment, regulated data or production systems before a human reviews its domain controls
